1922 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 12-29-1922, add 2 days to reach 12-31-1922.  
303 - 2 = 301 days left.  
1923 is not a leap year, so Jan–Oct: 365 days in 1923.  
301 days into 1923: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31 = 304 days from Jan 1 to Oct 31.  
301 days from Jan 1 is Oct 28, 1923 (since Oct 31 is day 304, Oct 28 is day 301).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1923-10-28
